rows.text: Blessed by Phagousa, the Carnival's Tail allows humans to temporarily conquer the ocean's waves. These insatiable machines continuously demand tribute, consuming honey brew and propelling wooden ships across the seas. Legend has it that Corinthus once toasted with a machine aboard, claiming to drink with Phagousa. The fine offering left the Carnival's Tail too intoxicated to control itself, crashing deep into the ocean. Days later, the hero and the ship's wreckage were disdainfully thrown ashore by Phagousa's Kin.
